build.buildCommand: bun install && DEPLOY_TARGET=node bun run build && echo '=== Build output ===' && (find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print | grep -E '(dist|output|build|server)' | head -40) && echo '=== Top-level dirs ===' && ls -la dist/ .output/ .vinxi/ 2>/dev/null || true

deploy.startCommand: echo '=== Looking for server entry ===' && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print | grep -iE '(server|ssr|entry)' | head -20 && echo '=== Trying to start ===' && node dist/server/index.js 2>/dev/null || node .output/server/index.mjs 2>/dev/null || node .vinxi/output/server/index.mjs 2>/dev/null || (echo 'ERROR: Could not find server entry point' && exit 1)
